test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which option figure would come next in the following figure series?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ff7b09e766bc16731167b6e45d2b7f6832bb320949074ea155103b5316e4e2a.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/010ad9256c49362a5f49664b11a21f0e940c7b74fa891cef17656dc83ec7555b.png] is change their position first clock-wise direction and in next figure anti-clock wise direction and so on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee989639427d3a089c269ca3fcb433012ec2573ce9043ae4794fcffa428ea5cf.png] 

2) Triangle change their position first in clock-wise direction and in next figure anti-clock wise direction and so on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1364ace8b9ce3a59e2118385e51596297a67ceff1ff93b0eb835b4d4617552d.png] 

3) Here circle is first rotate clock-wise and then anti-clock wise direction but replaced by # then they move anti-clock wise and then move clock-wise direction and replace Z, then Z move anti-clock wise direction then move clock-wise direction replace by 2

4) This all pattern are followed only in option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64ffdeb9f0f704f1a593b2b6e1c2a30c6badd5d0ce88893067f74e3325d3a727.png] 

Correct and complete pattern is here:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/q5g_y-eJxdGQsSXUhW3IWXhbJwYXdLPlx49fLCPV2QctEPT1HdtC3xmuZIkCaVMSOXufQdZPfuGiJKrzToQsSQL2AO6eg3yZk3TOCC9ng2KO5QvJ8rYVh0D96ytTqi7HfZWSrLKP4o7l9cPQeQ] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
